/poll question: Shoe Color and Logos: Color language change by cairo (crediting Emrys)
text:
Author: cairo (crediting Emrys)
Post: https://discord.com/channels/766364534495117383/1286801164326797385/1506430495129600130
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1lo8ZvQiqWejPt7OPK5_GRwGfFMbuJOqQsZfTC4a5zlw/edit?usp=sharing
Summary:
- Modern footwear: currently must be solid black or brown with matching laces; proposal adds 'or a solid color matching the player's garb' (safety plus garb continuity).
- Logo rule: currently logos must be removed, painted over, or covered invisibly; proposal allows a logo the same color as a solid-colored shoe (e.g. black logo on a black shoe).
- Historical footwear may be of any color (unchanged).
- Author explicitly intended this as two separate votes so neither change is a bridge too far.
answer-1: Yes
answer-2: No
answer-3: Abstain
